name: Seated Dumbbell Calf Raise
cues: Perch on the bench end, feet flat and shins upright
Stand the dumbbells on your lower thighs, just above the knees
Lift your heels as high as they go and hold the top
Lower slowly until your heels touch down again

qa.note: Wave 3a 2026-10-08: rated minor, owner review. minor: Thighs level, knees 90, shins upright. Ankle 0 to -34 (heel rises 7.7 cm, knees rise 5 cm). The dumbbell bottoms rest on the lower thighs about 10 cm above the knee joint, as cued, with hands closed on the handles. Ships with the 42 mm floor tolerance on the forefoot, which needs lead acceptance.
